academy_lead: Frequent bigrams and trigrams, morphemes, hard transitions, sentences and paragraphs: speed without losing accuracy.
academy_criterion: A module is complete when every exercise in it is mastered: three test attempts in a row at {floor}% accuracy or better. Speed is not counted.
academy_assumes_body: Stage 1 is not finished yet, but you can go straight in: the exercises assume every key is familiar. Test attempts, as everywhere, show no keyboard and no hints.
academy_assumes_done: Stage 1 is complete: every key is open, the Academy is yours.
academy_error: The course could not be loaded. Reload the page.
academy_not_found_body: The link may be out of date. Every exercise is on the Academy page.
academy_ex_practice_hint: Keyboard and next key on screen. Does not count towards mastery.
academy_ex_test_hint: No keyboard, no hints. Three of these in a row at {floor}% master the exercise.
academy_ex_layout_mismatch: Another layout seems to be on. Switch to {layout} and check again.
academy_result_below_floor: Accuracy {accuracy}% is below the {floor}% floor. Repeat the exercise in practice, more slowly: the speed will follow.
academy_result_test_after_practice: Practice cleared the floor. Now the test: {remaining} attempts in a row at {floor}%.
academy_result_test_after_test: Counted. Test attempts in a row at {floor}% still to go: {remaining}.
academy_result_course: The Academy course is complete. Every module is mastered.
academy_stage_note: Assumes every key; opens before Stage 1 is finished too.
academy_licence_use: the Academy course structure and hand-written exercises (typing-race-2026 courses), sentences and paragraphs from the knowledge library (Ukrainian road rules, cyber hygiene after NCSC, English grammar, humour from Project Gutenberg), the National Unity radio dictations 2010-2025 and the official text of the State Anthem of Ukraine. Authors of dictations and speeches are named in the exercise titles.
